title: Why would I deceive you? (Vex, Scribe; the Nov 2026 'Why would I deceive you?' trend, a sunny campus library)

voice.name: Mommy (generic Fish library voice, the user's pick Nov 9)

beats.say: Just five minutes on my phone. Why would I deceive you?
I read the whole chapter. Why would I deceive you? There's no reason for me to do that.
I'm staying in tonight. Why would I deceive you?
And I did my physics homework all by myself... Okay. That one was a lie.
I snapped one page of the textbook. Scribe solved every problem, drew every force diagram, and wrote it in my handwriting. In purple ink, obviously.
Mommy would never lie to you, baby.
